import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv(pd.compat.StringIO("""amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5"""))

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Transaction Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Transaction amount distribution by type
sns.boxplot(data=data, x='transaction_type', y='amount', ax=axes[0, 0], palette='Set2')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Transaction Amount by Type', fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Amount ($)')

# 2. Transaction count by type
transaction_counts = data['transaction_type'].value_counts()
axes[0, 1].bar(transaction_counts.index, transaction_counts.values, color=sns.color_palette('Set2'))
axes[0, 1].set_title('Transaction Count by Type', fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Count')
for i, v in enumerate(transaction_counts.values):
    axes[0, 1].text(i, v + 0.1, str(v), ha='center', va='bottom')

# 3. Transactions by hour of day
sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='hour_of_day', y='amount', hue='transaction_type', 
                s=200, alpha=0.7, ax=axes[1, 0], palette='Set2')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Transaction Amount vs Hour of Day', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Amount ($)')
axes[1, 0].legend(title='Type')

# 4. Hour distribution
axes[1, 1].hist(data['hour_of_day'], bins=24, color='skyblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Transaction Distribution by Hour', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Count')
axes[1, 1].set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
